firstScreen.notes: 1440-first.jpg: h1 'Worcester Porch Rebuilds' (trade+city+outcome, 3 words, 3 lines), clapboard-striped fill, signature elevation drawing on the right, phone in header and hero, rust primary + teal outline secondary, Sample proof line, cream band peeks ~65px. 390-first.jpg: h1 2 lines, both actions above fold, but mobile bar duplicates them and hides the peek.

distinctiveness.notes: 1440-rm-full.jpg: baluster rule tops hero, floor-1, services, floor-2, floor-3, footer; elevation badge tracks the floor (1440-scroll-25/50/75.jpg). carpenter/B/1440-first.jpg shares the hero composition (condensed headline left, line-drawn elevation right, rust dimension lines) (-0.5). Mono micro-labels and middle-dot strings in 1440-scroll-50.jpg (-0.5).

type.notes: 1440-first.jpg: strong scale contrast, Bebas against small kickers; curly quotes in reviews (1440-full.jpg). 1440-scroll-75.jpg: season-planner sentence set in DM Mono at ~20px, and prices wrap awkwardly in mono (1440-scroll-25.jpg) (-0.5). 1440-scroll-50.jpg: 3+ tracked-caps labels in one view (-0.5).

layout.notes: 1440-full.jpg: 10 single-job sections, good tone run with teal floor-3. Ink street break touches deep floor-2 and reads as one dark block (1440-scroll-50.jpg) (-1.0). #contact form ~300px wide floating in 1440 width, and #area sparse (1440-full.jpg) (-0.5).

photo.notes: Drawn plates judged on merit: one line weight and palette across hero, street break and baluster study (1440-scroll-50.jpg), part of the signature. 1440-full.jpg: elevation repeated hero then break (-0.5). 1440-scroll-25.jpg: floor-1 post plate weak, empty column below it (-0.5).

copy.notes: 1440-full.jpg: 'Porch railings and balusters' card repeated verbatim in #services and #floor-2 (-0.5). 1440-scroll-75.jpg: floor-3 lead repeats its h2 (-0.5). 1440-scroll-50.jpg: 'Get a trim quote' alongside 'Price it'/'Price a rebuild', and 'See full list' links to #contact (-0.5). Strong trade nouns and Sample labels.

mobile.notes: render.json: no overflow at 320/390. 390-first.jpg: hero re-cut with the drawing behind the text, h1 2 lines; mobile bar shown on load, duplicates the hero buttons and hides the peek (-0.5). 390-full.jpg: sections only stack, no phone-specific decisions.

a11y.notes: 1440-rm-full.jpg and 390-rm-full.jpg show every section and drawing with rules drawn. DOM: skip link, one h1, no skips, tab roles, live regions on checklist/ZIP, forced colors, labelled inputs. Empty ul.credits is minor.

motion.notes: Baluster rules draw on entry (absent in 1440-full.jpg, present in 1440-rm-full.jpg); badge lights floors 1/2/3 in 1440-scroll-25/50/75.jpg; tabs; split h1. The promised pinned elevation build shipped as three tiny corner boxes, and the hero drawing never moves (-0.5).

wow.notes: 1440-scroll-25.jpg: porch safety checklist is a useful trade tool, but its resting state is a plain checkbox list beside an empty column; no frame shows the designed result, and the elevation badge is too small to be the second moment (-0.5 vs blind round-3 score).

polish.notes: 1440-full.jpg footer: fake Pexels credits removed, honest 'Line drawings stand in' note. Favicon, OG, JSON-LD, print, forced colors present; square radius and one line weight across plates. Empty credits ul and a single arrow link keep it from 10.

elevate.move: Grow the triple-decker elevation from a corner badge into the page's navigation: a full-height drawn house in the left margin (≥900px) whose porch levels hold the floor section titles and jump to them, so the hero stops being 'headline left, drawing right' and the mono micro-labels can go.

Tie the hero elevation to scroll so each porch level draws in (posts, rail, balusters via stroke-dashoffset scrub) as its floor section enters, and have the safety checklist result light the matching floor in rust on the same drawing: one describable idea, 'the house builds as you scroll and the checker tells you which floor needs work'.
